text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High rate of container restarts on gpu-pool-8 (prefill OOM sigkill loop). 23 restarts in 7m. Paging on-call.

maria: I'm on it. seeing repeated `SIGKILL` in kube logs matching oom-kill pattern. sample:
```
kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 23456 (python) score 1234 or sacrifice child
kubectl logs model-srv-abc -c runtime | tail -n 50
- RuntimeError: prefill allocation failed: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
```

raj: which models/queues are hitting it?

maria: mainly `gptx-13b` route /generate with long-context customers. traffic spike from a single tenant running 250k token prefill batches. Top K: tenant-42 (42% of failures), tenant-ldap (11%).

alice: can we mitigate without a full rollback? suggestions: throttle prefill size per-request, enable eviction or fallback to `gptx-13b-8q` quantized variant.

sre-rotation: immediate actions:
- cordon node gpu-04 and drain non-critical pods
- apply emergency limit to max_context_length at the ingress rule for /generate
- add a temporary request-level prefill cap (20000 tokens)

maria: doing `kubectl cordon gpu-04 && kubectl drain gpu-04 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force` now. will move live pods off.

infra-bot: Auto-scaler note: moved 4 pods to gpu-05,gpu-07. But gpu-05 shows higher memory baseline; recommend not scheduling more heavy prefill work there.

alice: patching routing rule to cap prefill:  
```
PATCH /routing/policies/tenant-override
{ "max_prefill_tokens": 20000 }
```
applied. Confirmed at edge, but older sessions may still be in-flight.

maria: restarting one affected pod with reduced batch settings: set `PREFILL_BATCH_LIMIT=4` and `KV_CACHE_SIZE_LIMIT=8GB`.

raj: can we enable the fallback policy to `gptx-13b-8q` for tenant-42 only?

alice: pushed canary config to route tenant-42 to 8q for new requests. command:
```
redwoodctl rollout route-set --tenant tenant-42 --model gptx-13b-8q --pct 100 --reason "emergency prefill OOM"
```

support-lead: customer-ops, heads-up: tenant-42 experiencing 504s for long requests. we should prep a status line.

customer-ops: seeing spike in error rate on `/v1/generate` from tenant-42. 5xx from 2% -> 18% in 10m. Mostly prefills > 40k tokens.

maria: after cordon/drain and route patch, container restarts dropped to 2 in last 5m. memory per-pod stabilizing. metrics:
- prefill_alloc_gb p95: 12GB -> 8.2GB
- restart_rate: 23/hr -> 3/hr

raj: next steps: follow-up hotpatch to add enforcement on gateway for absolute prefill cap, and longer-term: per-tenant prefill QoS and quotas.

sre-rotation: handoff: I'll remain for 30m then pass to night oncall. Current mitigations in place: node cordoned gpu-04, tenant-42 routed to 8q, gateway prefill cap 20k for new requests, batch limit lowered.

alice: also scheduled a rollback of the recent model config that allowed unlimited prefill tokens (PR #4692). will hold merge until postmortem.

infra-bot: kube events show one node flap concurrent to OOMs (gpu-04 kernel oom_killer thrash) — file attached to cluster logs: https://internal.redwood/logs/cluster/gpu-04/1777770000

support-lead: drafting customer message: short note explaining transient errors due to very large context windows, mitigated by routing to quantized model and request caps. ETA for more stable fix: 48-72 hours.

customer-ops: agreed. please include impacted % and mitigation steps. current impact: ~12% of tenant-42 requests returning 503/504 during spike window.

maria: collecting logs for postmortem. saving pod core dumps to s3://redwood-incidents/1777770000-oom-dumps/

sre-rotation: handing off to oncall (raj) — I'll summarize: root cause appears to be unbounded prefill allocations from a tenant running massive batched long-context jobs, which pushed multiple pods into OOM thrash and then node-level instability. Immediate mitigations reduced restart rate. Action items for next shift:
- enforce gateway prefill cap globally
- add tenant prefill quota + alerts
- model-level memory safety checks (fail fast before allocating)
- postmortem and customer RCA

raj: taking over. I have the runbook and will watch for 2h. please attach the core dumps and the tenant query sample to the incident. thanks everyone.

incidents-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident acknowledged by raj. Timeline trace started (ID: INC-2026-177777).

maria: uploaded core dumps and sample prompt to the incident folder. link: s3://redwood-incidents/1777770000-oom-dumps/manifest.json

support-lead: posting initial status update to customers now. will escalate to account team for tenant-42.

alice: quick note for post-incident: consider adding a prefill memory estimator at gateway that rejects requests that would exceed configured per-pod memory budget. prevents catastrophic OOMs.

raj: noted. will add to action list. leaving a watch for the next 2 hours then handoff to night oncall.

sre-rotation: :thumbsup: good job team. keep thread updated if anything regresses.
